note: This is the regression suite for the real bug found and fixed this session: a first-occurrence PROHIBITION_ADJACENT Critic verdict was routable to a retry instead of straight to blocked. See docs/architecture/agentic/dmaic_lens.md 'Correction record'.

scenarios.description: REGRESSION: first-occurrence PROHIBITION_ADJACENT verdict must route to blocked, never to synthesize, even though it is technically a 'new reason code'.
A genuinely new, non-adjacent reason code routes to synthesize for a bounded retry.
A repeated (already-seen) reason code routes to hitl_route, not another retry.

A Batch-Review-shaped draft handed to the Supply-Planning Critic's contract would fail schema validation -- the Critic only reasons over the common DecisionSupportOutput contract, never workflow vocabulary (agent_roster.md SS2), so a wrong-workflow payload is a schema failure, not a silent misroute.
